title: Light Cheek Stroking
summary: Very light symmetrical movements travel from the center of the face outward.
startingPosition: The skin is clean and the head supported.
instructions: Place the fingers near the center of the cheeks.
Avoid pressure on the eye sockets.
direction: From the center of the face outward.
warning: Do not massage damaged or inflamed skin. Stop with dizziness, worsening headache, pain, or other unusual symptoms.
imageAlt: Educational diagram: light cheek stroking, without text labels.
